**A small update for v0.8.** One hitch gone, softer glare, and shots that
light bright rooms properly.

**No more hitches every few seconds.** With F4 → Graphics → Frame presentation
set to Fast, Adaptive or Off, the game asked the graphics driver every frame
which ways of showing a frame the window supports. On some drivers that
question took 2 ms each time, and every few seconds it took 50 to 60 ms: a
one- or two-frame hitch even when standing still in an empty level. It now asks
once. VSync was never affected.

**Softer glare.** Looking from a dark room into a bright one, the bright room
used to be a flat white shape with a hard edge. Light that burns out now glows
past its edge, with a wider halo around it, and dark paint in the glare lifts
with the bright parts, so DOOM's contrasty textures no longer look rough there.
This applies with F4 Lighting set to Whole level.

**Shots in bright rooms.** Muzzle flashes and other shot light barely showed
in brightly lit rooms, and in warm-lit ones they could turn the walls cyan.
They now flash as they should. Your eyes also no longer adjust to your own
muzzle flash, and the weapon's own flash frames always show at full
brightness.

**Voice pack.** The soldiers' spoken lines are a separate download,
`derp-voices.wad`, attached to this release with its licence
(`VOICES-LICENSE.txt`). It is the same file as in v0.8: if you have it, keep
it; if not, put it beside your game WAD. Without it the soldiers only cry
out.

## Known issue

- **Odd lighting after a mid-level change.** A light switch or similar change
  in the middle of a level can light the area oddly. Cycling through the F4
  presets fixes it.
